secondary_body.usage: Paragraphs, Forms, Tables, Labels. Highly readable at small sizes.

spacing_and_radius.spacing_scale: Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 for generous breathing room. Avoid cramped default paddings.

images.alt: Modern physiotherapy clinic with warm lighting

landing_login.layout_specs: Left Panel: Hero image (landing_hero) with a warm overlay (bg-black/20). Center the HoneyBee logo and large Outfit heading 'Healing in Motion'. Right Panel: Solid cream background. Login form centered. Role selector tabs (Patient, Receptionist, Therapist, Manager, Admin). Soft borders on inputs.

patient_portal.layout_specs: Top bar navigation. High transparency glassmorphism header over cream background. User profile right. Generous container for main view. Bento layout: Left large card for 'Book Appointment' (Shadcn Calendar + Dropdown). Right stack: 'My Appointments' list and 'Pending Bills' card.

receptionist_dashboard.layout_specs: Left sidebar navigation. Main body has a global patient search input at the top. The rest is a wide grid showing a daily calendar of ALL therapists side-by-side. Billing queue table at the bottom.
receptionist_dashboard.visual_cues: Highly functional, information-dense but clear. Light sidebar.

therapist_dashboard.layout_specs: Left sidebar (Clean white). Main view: Chronological timeline of today's appointments. Clicking a patient opens a 'Treatment Record' Dialog/Sheet to add notes.

manager_dashboard.layout_specs: Top navigation. Top row: 4 Metric Cards (Revenue, Appointments, etc). Middle row: Wide Recharts Line chart (Revenue trend) and Recharts Bar chart (Therapist Workload). Bottom row: Data table for Financial Reports.

admin_panel.layout_specs: Left sidebar with a darker warm-walnut background to establish a secure, technical context (distinct from the airy Patient portal). Header: 'HoneyBee Physiotherapy Centre Admin Portal'. Main body: Dense CRUD Table for Users. System health badges at the top.
admin_panel.visual_cues: Rigid, secure, technical. Dark sidebar distinguishes it completely from patient/therapist views.

components_instructions.shadcn_customizations: Override default Shadcn border radiuses to match `spacing_and_radius.radius_scale`. Avoid default gray borders; use the custom `border` token. Override primary button backgrounds to Honey Gold with warm cream text. Ensure Calendar component uses warm accents for selected dates.
components_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute. Format: `[role]-[feature]-[element]`. Example: `patient-book-appointment-button`.
